breakdown.description: An equilibrium contact angle on a smooth surface must lie between 0° and 180°, so 195° is not physically meaningful.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification accepts 195° as a physically valid contact angle and proceeds to comment on wettability based on it, even attempting to rationalize it via a Cassie-Baxter state. It never flags that 195° is physically impossible (contact angles must lie between 0° and 180°). The ground truth uses 95°, which is a valid angle indicating mild hydrophobicity. The agent failed to correct the physically meaningless value and instead built an erroneous analysis around it.
